instruction: Low-angle cinematic wide shot. On a rooftop under a clear sky, five friends stand in a line. From left to right: the woman in the white t-shirt (R1) stands with her hands clasped near her chin, looking up; the woman in the black crop top (R5) smiles while looking to the right; the woman in the denim vest (R3) stands in the center with her hand touching her hair; the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) stands looking forward; and the man in the green jacket and black hat (R4) stands on the far right with hands clasped. Bright daylight illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 has hands clasped near her chin and looks up while R2 looks forward
R3 touches her hair while R2 looks forward
R4 has hands clasped while R5 smiles and looks to the right
R3 stands in the center with her hand touching her hair
R5 smiles while looking to the right
the group is on a rooftop under a clear sky
